headline: Marcopolo Q3 Net Income Falls 43% on Lower Revenue and Margins
summary: Marcopolo registered a net income of R$ 186.5 million in the third quarter of 2026, down 43.4% year-over-year, alongside an 8.5% drop in net operating revenue.
why: Marcopolo is a major bus and coach manufacturer whose financial results reflect industrial production activity and commercial vehicle demand.

impacts.name: Marcopolo
impacts.why: Net income fell 43.4% and net revenue declined 8.5% in the third quarter.
